newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers little changed, direction mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers little changed, direction mixed.

text.p: Singapore bunkers on Thursday were little changed with most traders mixed on near term market direction after crude plunges overnight.
While paper prices have fallen about 75 cents, crude oil prices have recovered from its earlier losses, traders said.
Most traders are mixed on near term direction. Some traders anticipate bunker prices to rise as a local buyer was expected to prop up cargo levels.
Bunker 180-cst supplies were quoted at $128 and 380-cst at around $123. MDO quotes were at $230-$250 and gas oil steady at $254-$257. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
